changeObjective: Expand bounded non-VPN/non-proxy Direct Method coverage for Gemini and an optional adult-site live check, while preserving hostlist scoping, rollback and no-default-route/no-proxy invariants.

evidenceFirstRationale.claim: zapret --hostlist applies DPI desync only to listed hosts and subdomains are automatically included unless the entry is prefixed with ^.

zapret supports auto-hostlist, but it requires broader failure detection/incoming traffic handling; it is not promoted in this change set because explicit host-scoped coverage is simpler and sufficient for the concrete failing target unless testing proves otherwise.
Gemini web app is officially available in Azerbaijan; a curl HTTP 403 demonstrates reachability but does not prove browser usability or a network block.

plannedMutation.semantics: 2xx/3xx = PASS; successful HTTP transport with non-success status such as 403 = REACHABLE but not PASS; curl/network failure = FAIL.
plannedMutation.adultUiPrivacy: UI label is Adult site; explicit domain is not displayed in the application UI.
plannedMutation.startGate: Gemini/adult checks are diagnostics only and do not cause Start rollback; existing core YouTube/OpenAI/GitHub live gate remains authoritative.

invariants: Adult live check is user-toggleable and defaults off
exactNextAction: Commit/push exact candidate, independently reproduce Linux archive on aliemad-Labtop, perform the one-time protected backend 1.5 upgrade, then execute live Gemini/adult Start->Stop->Recovery before protected release.

implemented.liveCheckSemantics: PASS=allowed 2xx/3xx; REACHABLE=HTTP transport completed but application rejected/non-success; FAIL=transport failure
implemented.linuxUpdaterHardening: exact-one expected Linux asset + exact-one SHA256SUMS + GitHub API digest == checksum file == downloaded ZIP
implemented.routerGatewayDiagnostics: PPTP TCP/1723 control reachability explicitly does not prove GRE/auth; L2TP/IPsec generic TCP/443 fallback explicitly does not prove UDP 500/4500/authenticated tunnel

additionalDecisions.claim: Do not enable zapret auto-hostlist in v1.5.0 before explicit target live validation.
additionalDecisions.evidence: Official zapret documentation states nfqws auto-hostlist requires both incoming and outgoing traffic redirection and recommends connbytes filtering to avoid processing large incoming traffic volumes.

additionalDecisions.claim: Linux updater uses three-way digest agreement before executing a downloaded update.
additionalDecisions.evidence: GitHub release API supplies asset digest; v1.5 code requires API digest, SHA256SUMS entry and downloaded ZIP SHA-256 to match exactly.
